out.explanation: Page 45 states the total secured loan is ₹ 499.48 million, whereas page 364 states fund-based borrowings of ₹ 88.85 million, non-fund-based borrowings of ₹ 410.63 million, and unsecured loans of ₹ 10.19 million aggregating to ₹ 509.67 million. This implies the non-fund-based borrowings of ₹ 410.63 million are included in the secured total on page 45, conflicting with the typical distinction between fund-based and non-fund-based facilities.
